notThisDoor: Eve extension with tools, hooks, MCP, channels, or schedules
conquistador runtime, catalog, Eval Lab, app/
hostProvides: optional sandbox, memory, channels, and connections declared by the consuming Eve app
conquistadorOwns: approval boundary for send, publish, spend, and external writes
missingCapabilities: Eve tools, hooks, MCP servers, channels, and schedules in this package

lifecycle.setup: Create or open an Eve agent. Copy instructions.md into agent/instructions.md. Stage canonical skills into agent/skills/.
lifecycle.upgrade: Replace agent/instructions.md and each owned agent/skills/<name> tree from a newer source. Do not fetch at runtime.
lifecycle.remove: Delete the owned Conquistador instructions and agent/skills/<name> trees. Leave other Eve app files.
